issues.issue: Internal shock assembly, service fluid and rod-end adjustment are withheld.
issues.source: Legacy XAM-7M system differs from current check-nut callout; actual shipped strut configuration not established. OA-001 specifies a recommended 5/8 in minimum rod-end thread engagement and describes configuration-dependent adjustment points.
issues.check: Confirm strut model, bearings, bushings and current assembly/service instructions before loading aircraft. Verify minimum engagement using the applicable factory method; exposed thread length alone is not an engagement measurement. Use GEAR001 step03 for loaded spread.
